utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely, and folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that so? I’d want to hear exactly what they still need before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Fair enough — I’ll ask around and get you a straight list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll try to keep up with the updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan so folks don’t miss it. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in for the repair drive. Tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — can you bring a few basic tools, some gloves, and any spare screws or tape you’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring tools, gloves, and whatever screws or tape I can find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, but I’m still catching up on the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Rey — I’m keeping a list, and we could use screws, a few paint cans, and some gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some gloves and check for screws today. How many paint cans do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule if you need, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send over the repair drive details so you can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, send them when you can and I’ll take a look. I’ll work around the school schedule once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—let’s keep it simple and steady. Tell me the plan, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple and steady — I’ll jot down the repair drive plan and we can just follow that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—write it down, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, the repair drive’s coming up soon—want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe put me as a maybe for now—I need to check my schedule and make sure I can actually help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mark you down as a maybe and check back with you later. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—what’s the latest on where they need help most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re in pretty good shape, but we still need a few more hands for sorting donations and coordinating pickups. If you know anyone who can spare an hour or two, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can pass that along—I’ve got a couple neighbors I can ask about the sorting, and I’ll send anyone available your way for pickups too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll send the repair drive details right over now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for the details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help where I can, but I’m keeping things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key too, and I can still swing by late if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Late is fine — just keep it quiet and I’ll let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Can you bring a hammer, screwdriver, and tape?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdriver, and tape over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where is the repair drive supposed to be held?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s at the community center, but I’d want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s double-check then—I’ll look up the community center address.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’d really help. I’ll let you know what tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when you are. Just give me a shout and I’ll bring whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the exact drop-off time and what kind of items they’ll accept first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s get that confirmed first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, and if there’s a cutoff for bulk items, I’d like to know that too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara — I’m glad to help keep the repair drive moving. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you help sort the donated tools and make a quick list of anything we still need?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a quick list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick tally of what we still need for the repair drive—what’s already covered, and what should I mark down next?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—I can help with the tally. What’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—let’s mark down any tools, wood, and screws first, then I’ll note whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up steam, and folks are pitching in with tools and supplies. If you want, I can swing by and tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess—thank you. I’m trying to work around the school schedule, so I’d love to know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check in and come back with the latest—last I heard, they still needed a few hand tools and some sturdy boxes for supplies. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just send me the basics and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the repair list, timing, and what supplies we still need. Really appreciate you taking a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — send the list when you can, and I’ll skim it and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what kind of repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I mean the neighborhood repair drive—tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers to help folks with small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great — I can help gather tools and spare parts, and I might be able to round up a couple volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away—who should I invite first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Maybe start with the folks on Maple Street first—they’re usually the quickest to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll start with Maple Street and let them know ASAP.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the repair drive is still over by the community center lot, unless they moved it this morning. I can check the usual spots if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple and check the community center lot first. If it’s not there, then we can look at the usual spots.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll start at the community center lot and report back if it’s not there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, what time is the repair drive starting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I haven’t checked the start time yet, so I don’t want to guess. Let me confirm the details and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Please let me know once you confirm the start time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—what do you need from me while I’m out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Ira—if you could pick up some heavy-duty tape and a few replacement screws, that’d be a huge help. I’ll probably forget the exact size, but I’ll try to jot it down before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll grab the tape and screws, and I can swing back by if you remember the size before I checkout.
